ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda ransomware safe-mode reboot to neuter EDR before encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the distinctive Qilin pre-encryption chain where the operator configures Windows to boot into Safe Mode with networking, registers the ransomware binary as a SafeBoot-aware service, and force-reboots the host so EDR/AV does not start. This bcdedit+SafeBoot+forced-reboot triad is a documented signature of Qilin (Agenda) intrusions reported by Trend Micro, Sophos X-Ops and Group-IB.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as procs dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_procs min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" Processes.process="*safeboot*" Processes.process="*set*") OR (Processes.process_name="reg.exe" Processes.process="*\\SafeBoot\\*") OR (Processes.process_name="shutdown.exe" (Processes.process="* /r*" OR Processes.process="* -r*") Processes.process="*/t*")) Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=30m | where distinct_procs>=2 | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// Qilin (Agenda) safe-mode reboot prep — bcdedit + SafeBoot reg + forced restart within 30 min
let Lookback = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot" and ProcessCommandLine has "set")
     or (FileName =~ "reg.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has @"\SafeBoot\")
     or (FileName =~ "shutdown.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (" /r"," -r") and ProcessCommandLine has "/t")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"            // drop machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Procs = make_set(FileName, 10),
            DistinctActions = dcount(FileName),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 30m)
| where DistinctActions >= 2                  // need at least 2 of the 3 binaries in the same 30 min window
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Qilin (Agenda) safe-mode reboot prep — Sentinel via SecurityEvent 4688
let Lookback = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "safeboot" and CommandLine has "set")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\reg.exe" and CommandLine has @"\SafeBoot\")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\shutdown.exe" and CommandLine has_any (" /r"," -r") and CommandLine has "/t")
| where Account !endswith "$"
| summarize Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            Procs = make_set(NewProcessName, 10),
            DistinctActions = dcount(NewProcessName),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
          by Computer, Account, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where DistinctActions >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Safe-Mode Boot Preparation
id: 8b1c7b2e-7a3d-4f6c-9d8e-3b5c4d6e7f8a
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit being used to enable SafeBoot, a hallmark of Qilin (Agenda) ransomware's pre-encryption staging where the host is rebooted into safe mode to neuter EDR/AV before T1486 encryption.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/c/agenda-ransomware-targets-vcenter-esxi.html
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/02
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  bcdedit_safeboot:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'safeboot'
      - 'set'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: bcdedit_safeboot and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT recovery / repair workflows (rare and usually scripted with a named ticket)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SafeBoot* OR *SAFEBOOT*) @CommandLine:(*set* OR *SET*)) OR (@Image:(*\\reg.exe OR *\\REG.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\\SafeBoot\\* OR *\\safeboot\\*)) OR (@Image:(*\\shutdown.exe OR *\\SHUTDOWN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"/r"* OR *"-r"*) @CommandLine:*"/t"*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ((ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/safeboot/i CommandLine=/\bset\b/i)
   OR (ImageFileName=/\\reg\.exe$/i CommandLine=/\\SafeBoot\\/i)
   OR (ImageFileName=/\\shutdown\.exe$/i CommandLine=/[\/-]r\b/i CommandLine=/[\/-]t\s+\d+/i))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=hits), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true)])
| hits >= 1
ucs.rationale: Generic ransomware UCs trigger on shadow-copy deletion or encryption file events — by then encryption is already running. The safe-mode reboot path is a Qilin/Agenda signature: Trend Micro, Sophos X-Ops and Group-IB all document Qilin operators executing bcdedit /set {default} safeboot minimal (or network), writing the ransomware service under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot\Network

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin GPO-deployed PowerShell stealer dumping Chrome/Edge Login Data
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin-distinctive credential-harvesting step disclosed by Sophos X-Ops in August 2024: after gaining DC privileges, Qilin pushes a logon-script GPO that runs IPScanner.ps1 / Logger.ps1 on every domain endpoint, copying %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data and Local State and exfiltrating them. This combination — GPO logon script parent (gpscript.exe / userinit.exe) spawning PowerShell that touches Chrome's SQLite credential store — is uniquely Qilin tradecraft, not generic stealer behaviour.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user min(_time) as first_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","winlogon.exe") OR Processes.parent_process="*\\GroupPolicy\\*" OR Processes.parent_process="*gpscript*") (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*Edge\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*Local State*" OR Processes.process="*IPScanner*" OR Processes.process="*Logger.ps1*" OR Processes.process="*sqlite*" OR Processes.process="*AES_GCM*" OR Processes.process="*EncryptedKey*") Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
// Qilin (Agenda) Chrome credential stealer pushed via GPO logon script
// Sophos X-Ops, Aug 2024 — IPScanner.ps1 / Logger.ps1 dropped via SYSVOL
let Lookback = 14d;
let StealerSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","winlogon.exe")
       or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\GroupPolicy\", "gpscript", "\SYSVOL\", "Scripts\Logon")
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data", @"Chrome\User Data", @"Edge\User Data",
                                       "Local State", "sqlite", "IPScanner", "Logger.ps1",
                                       "AES_GCM", "EncryptedKey", "DPAPI", "os_crypt")
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
            ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
            ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
            ChildPid   = ProcessId,
            ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
            SHA256;
let ChromeTouch = DeviceFileEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
  | where (FileName in~ ("Login Data","Login Data-journal","Local State","Cookies","Web Data")
           and FolderPath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\", @"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\"))
  | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
            FilePath = strcat(FolderPath, FileName),
            FileAction = ActionType,
            PSPid = InitiatingProcessId;
StealerSpawn
| join kind=inner ChromeTouch on DeviceId
| where ChildPid == PSPid
| where FileTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildCmd, FilePath, FileAction
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Qilin Chrome credential stealer via GPO logon script — Sentinel (SecurityEvent 4688)
let Lookback = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe"
     or ParentProcessName endswith "\\userinit.exe"
     or ParentProcessName endswith "\\winlogon.exe"
     or CommandLine has_any (@"\GroupPolicy\", @"\SYSVOL\", "Scripts\\Logon")
| where CommandLine has_any ("Login Data", @"Chrome\User Data", @"Edge\User Data",
                              "Local State", "sqlite", "IPScanner", "Logger.ps1",
                              "AES_GCM", "EncryptedKey", "os_crypt")
| where Account !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE) (@ParentImage:(*\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\userinit.exe OR *\\USERINIT.EXE OR *\\winlogon.exe OR *\\WINLOGON.EXE) OR @ParentCommandLine:(*\\GroupPolicy\\* OR *\\SYSVOL\\* OR *gpscript* OR *Scripts\\Logon*)) @CommandLine:(*"Login Data"* OR *"Chrome\\User Data"* OR *"Edge\\User Data"* OR *"Local State"* OR *sqlite* OR *IPScanner* OR *Logger.ps1* OR *AES_GCM* OR *EncryptedKey* OR *os_crypt*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| (ParentBaseFileName=/(gpscript|userinit|winlogon)\.exe$/i
   OR regex("(\\\\GroupPolicy\\\\|\\\\SYSVOL\\\\|Scripts\\\\Logon)", field=ParentCommandLine))
| regex("(Login Data|Chrome\\\\User Data|Edge\\\\User Data|Local State|sqlite|IPScanner|Logger\\.ps1|AES_GCM|EncryptedKey|os_crypt|DPAPI)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(as=hits), collect([CommandLine], multival=true)])
ucs.rationale: This catches a specific Qilin tradecraft that no other known ransomware crew has been observed running at scale: weaponising domain GPO logon scripts as a fan-out credential dumper before the encryption phase. Sophos X-Ops named the dropped scripts (IPScanner.ps1, Logger.ps1) and confirmed the parent chain runs as gpscript.exe → powershell.exe, touching %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Defau
